LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…
Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!
Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!
What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!
Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.
Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.
